title: Portland, ME — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Portland, ME: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Portland is a city in ME with a population of 68,408. Foodie paradise with lobster, lighthouses, and New England coastal charm. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
